failure_stage: PowerShell stderr handling during TabM embedding construction
exception: NativeCommandError: a non-fatal rtdl_num_embeddings single-bin UserWarning was promoted to a terminating shell error by ErrorActionPreference=Stop
interpretation: The child process emitted the expected warning while constructing a piecewise-linear embedding for a binary feature. PowerShell terminated the wrapper before a benchmark report or log file was materialized; no metric or model result exists for this attempt.
resolution: The known constructor warning is now suppressed only around PiecewiseLinearEmbeddings construction. The replacement benchmark uses a new v2 run identifier and non-terminating native stderr handling.
